Find YT, given that Y=[−20015960.5].

[−20960150.5]
b

c
[20−90−6−15−0.5]

[−20015960.5]

decision.explanation: Transposing swaps rows and columns. The rows of Y become the columns of Y^T, giving rows (-20, 9), (0, 6), and (15, 0.5).

after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{Y}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-20 & 9 \\ 0 & 6 \\ 15 & 0.5\end{aligned}]
$$
